rows.question: Show me the acronyms of projects that started in 2018
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT acronym
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    (CASE
       WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer
       ELSE p.start_year
     END) AS derived_start_year
  FROM projects p
) t
WHERE derived_start_year = 2018
ORDER BY acronym

rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH nord_regions AS (
  SELECT geocode_regions
  FROM eu_territorial_units
  WHERE description ILIKE '%nordjylland%'
),
institutions_in_nord AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id,
    i.institutions_name,
    i.acronym,
    i.short_name,
    i.country_id,
    i.geocode_regions_3,
    i.grid_id,
    i.website,
    i.db_pedia_url,
    i.wikidata_url,
    i.document_vectors
  FROM institutions i
  WHERE i.geocode_regions_3 IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM nord_regions nr
      WHERE i.geocode_regions_3 = nr.geocode_regions
         OR i.geocode_regions_3 LIKE nr.geocode_regions || '%'
    )
)
SELECT *
FROM institutions_in_nord

rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_with_country AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.country_id,
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code2,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.short_name AS region_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.document_vectors::text AS latitude, -- lifted literals: none; keep column types but document_vectors not latitude, so cast to text placeholder
  NULL::numeric AS longitude
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
),
project_members_clean AS (
SELECT
  unics_id,
  project,
  pic_number,
  rcn,
  member_name,
  activity_type,
  country,
  street,
  city,
  postal_code,
  ec_contribution,
  institution_id,
  member_role,
  geocode_regions_3,
  member_short_name,
  department_name,
  vat_number,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  region_code,
  region_name
FROM project_members
),
project_members_location_cohort AS (
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.country,
  pm.geocode_regions_3,
  pm.region_name,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.member_short_name
FROM project_members_clean pm
)
SELECT institutions_name
FROM institutions_with_country
WHERE (
  lower(coalesce(geocode_regions_3, '')) = lower('Nordjylland')
  OR lower(coalesce(region_name, '')) = lower('Nordjylland')
)

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members

FROM projects p
JOIN (
  SELECT project::integer AS project_id,
         COUNT(*)::integer AS member_count
  FROM project_members

) pmc ON p.unics_id = pmc.project_id

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    ec_fund_scheme
  FROM projects
),
projects_count_by_funding_scheme AS (
  SELECT
    p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS project_count
  FROM projects_core p
  WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme
)
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title,
  p.project_count
FROM projects_count_by_funding_scheme p
JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON fs.code = p.ec_fund_scheme
WHERE p.project_count = (
  SELECT MAX(project_count) FROM projects_count_by_funding_scheme
)
ORDER BY fs.code

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_year_duration AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year,
    (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects
  WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND end_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  pyd.unics_id,
  pyd.acronym,
  pyd.title,
  pyd.start_year,
  pyd.end_year,
  pyd.duration_years
FROM project_year_duration pyd
WHERE pyd.duration_years = (
  SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM project_year_duration
)
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, pyd.unics_id
